Class CliScreen

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.Screen
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.cli.cliScreens.CliScreen
Direct Known Subclasses:
CliAdventureScreen, CliCrewInitializationScreen, CliEndGameScreen, CliGameCreationScreen, CliJoinOrCreateScreen, CliLobbyScreen, CliNicknameChoiceScreen, CliSecondShipBuildingScreen, CliTestShipBuildingScreen, CliValidationScreen
public abstract class CliScreen extends Screen
Base class for all command-line interface screens in the game. Provides common functionality for managing game state, player ships, and user interface elements across different game phases. Each game screen extends this class to implement its unique behavior.

      public CliScreen(ClientModel model, ClientControllerInterface controller, GameState gameState)
      Creates a new CLI screen with the given game state and controller. Initializes the screen's UI elements, player ships, and available actions.
      Parameters:
      model - The client model containing the current game state
      controller - The controller for sending commands to the server
      gameState - The current game state containing available actions and player information
